chapters.title: A decoder from input to output
chapters.caption: Follow tokens through 32 decoder layers. One representative layer is enlarged; labeled spans compress the others. Depth separates parallel heads and experts.
chapters.misconception: The stack shows computation, not physical parameter placement.
chapters.acceptance: One representative frame and labeled collapsed spans preserve the 32-layer sequence and continuous path.

chapters.title: Tokens become vectors
chapters.caption: Each illustrative token ID selects a learned embedding row: a vector with 4,096 coordinates.
chapters.misconception: Displayed chunks are illustrative; token vocabulary entries differ from context positions.
chapters.acceptance: Token labels, illustrative IDs, embedding lookup and a sampled activation are readable.

chapters.title: Select a decoder layer
chapters.caption: Every layer repeats this structure with its own weights. Enter the representative frame; labeled spans account for the other layers.
chapters.misconception: Reused geometry does not imply shared model weights.
chapters.acceptance: One persistent representative interior is visible, with the selected layer identity preserved.

chapters.title: Normalize, project, retain the residual
chapters.caption: RMSNorm scales the representation. Separate learned projections form Q, K and V, while the residual bypass retains the incoming activation.
chapters.misconception: The bypass carries the activation around attention and reconnects at addition.
chapters.acceptance: RMSNorm, three projections, first bypass and addition are traceable.

chapters.title: Shared keys and values, causal attention
chapters.caption: Four query heads share one K/V pair. RoPE rotates Q and K by position. Causal attention gathers values only from the current and earlier tokens.
chapters.misconception: Values do not receive the Q/K positional rotation; future tokens receive zero weight.
chapters.acceptance: Four Q sheets connect to one K/V pair; allowed weights sum to one and future links are absent.

chapters.title: Keep earlier keys and values
chapters.caption: Prefill stores the prompt’s keys and values in every layer. Decode adds the new token’s entries and reuses the retained rows.
chapters.misconception: The cache stores per-layer activations, not weights or precomputed answers.
chapters.acceptance: Token-position rows remain unchanged as one new row appears in each K/V sheet.

chapters.title: Choose two of eight experts
chapters.caption: After the attention residual and second RMSNorm, a router scores eight experts for this token. The two selected probabilities are renormalized to sum to one.
chapters.misconception: Expert selection varies by token and layer; these experts have no assigned topic labels.
chapters.acceptance: Eight logits and probabilities, exactly two routes, normalized selected weights, and both residual paths are inspectable.

chapters.title: Transform, weight and merge
chapters.caption: Each selected expert transforms the same activation with gate/up projections, SiLU, multiplication and down projection. Their weighted output vectors merge before the residual addition.
chapters.misconception: Routing combines expert output vectors, not the learned expert weights.
chapters.acceptance: Only one expert detail opens; two weighted outputs reach the merge and residual addition.

chapters.title: Compute vocabulary scores
chapters.caption: The representation passes through the remaining layers and final RMSNorm. The LM head produces vocabulary logits; a selection rule chooses the next token.
chapters.misconception: Logits are scores; token selection is a separate step. Candidate probabilities here are illustrative.
chapters.acceptance: Remaining layers, final normalization, logits and next-token selection appear in order.

chapters.title: Continue with the new token
chapters.caption: Append the chosen token and run its next decode step through every layer, reusing earlier K/V entries. Pause anywhere to explore the same model.
chapters.misconception: Cached decode processes the new position while reusing the prompt’s stored keys and values.
chapters.acceptance: One appended position follows the return path; retained cache rows remain visible on inspection.
